audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read Orianna, Orianna, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Orianna while the content layer and packet levelChart both read Skill x4 then Lissandra x3. Five of seven rows disagreed across layers. The page also rated the lane TRICKY 7/10 against a 54.58% win rate over 1702 games.
audit.why: Orianna out-ranges Lissandra (815 Q to 725) but has no dash and no self-peel against a point-and-click stun; the content layer, the packet chart and the win rate all say the lane turns at 6 and stays turned.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides moved onto the content values (Skill x4, Lissandra x3), and diff/diffRating/tone/carryRating brought in line with the win rate: EVEN, 5/10, Orianna threat 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was the generic anti-assassin template; Orianna is neither an assassin nor a diver.
audit.why: What actually changes at 6 is that Frozen Tomb needs no ball while Command: Shockwave does — Lissandra's ultimate is self-sufficient and Orianna's is positional.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states the ball dependency and that Orianna has no dash and no way to peel the tomb.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit and never said what Shockwave actually does to your position.
audit.why: Command: Shockwave launches enemies TOWARD the ball, not away from Orianna — so the ball's location, not hers, decides where you end up. Command: Attack drops to a 3s cooldown at rank 5, and Command: Protect is a flat 9s shield that also grants armour and MR.
audit.corrected: Named Shockwave at 110s rank 1 / 80s maxed with the pull-toward-ball behaviour, Q at 7s down to 3s, and E at a flat 9s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 54.58% win rate contradicts a TRICKY 7/10 difficulty label.
audit.why: 1702 games is a large enough sample that a five-point positive win rate should not be presented as a hard lane.
